info.title: D-Sports API
info.description: Public API for the D-Sports fan engagement platform (PWA backend). Most endpoints require Clerk Bearer authentication.

post.summary: Exchange mobile session token for Clerk ticket
post.description: One-time redeem of a Prisma MobileSession hex token (body `{ token }` or Authorization Bearer) for a Clerk sign-in ticket. No Clerk session required. Consumes the mobile session.

token.description: 64-byte mobile session token as 128 hex chars

get.description: Redirects to mobile auth. Query: provider, redirect_uri.
Verifies Bearer token from native app.

get.description: List teams with enriched stats, or look up one team with ?slug=. Archived slugs 404 regardless of casing. Payload includes fans, totalPoints, rank, lastWinner, isOfficial, league, themeColor, leaderboardId, leagueInfo, leagueColors, never-null sport, plus _count { packs, collectibles }.

200.description: { success, data: { teams, season } } or { success, data: { team } } when slug is set

get.description: Teams the authenticated user follows.
Cursor-paginated team search. Query: q (max 64), sport, league, cursor, limit (1-50), sort (rank | name | fans).

post.description: Body optional: { type?: 'followed' | 'fan' }.
Idempotent leaderboard membership only. Does not write TeamFollow. Returns { joinedTeamIds, followedTeamIds }.

delete.description: Idempotent. Removes only the leaderboard entry. Social follow stays in place. Returns { joinedTeamIds, followedTeamIds }.

get.description: Public real-player roster for the lineup builder. { players: [{ id, name, jersey, position, role, duty }] }. 404 if team is missing.
suggest=1: suggested users (auth). No id: current user (auth). id and/or handle: public profile.
Public case-insensitive handle check. Query: username. Returns { available: boolean }.

password.description: Optional password for explicit re-authentication prior to deletion.

post.description: Onboarding payload.

get.description: Authenticated settings row. Creates one from User.isPrivate when missing. privateProfile mirrors isPrivate. Includes per-channel notify* booleans and accessibility flags.

patch.description: Boolean fields only plus appearanceTheme. Persist notifyTeams, notifyMilestones, notifyCommunity separately. Do not write preferences.privacy.

get.summary: List joined and followed team IDs
get.description: Returns { joinedTeamIds, followedTeamIds } for the authenticated user.
Public ownership, sale, and mint history assembled from UserCollectible, MarketSale, and MintedNFT. No dedicated card_provenance table.

200.description: { success: true, data: { card, currentOwners[], transfers[], mints[] } }

get.summary: Fan Rep totals split by source
get.description: Sums Fan, Club, Player, and Direct ledger rows for the authenticated user. clubRepByTeam only includes Club targetIds that resolve to a Team.

200.description: { totalFanRep, fanAmpRep, dsportsDirectRep, clubRep, playerAmpRep, clubRepByTeam[] }

get.description: Keyset pagination on createdAt DESC, id DESC. Sources: fanAmp, club, playerAmp, dsportsDirect.

200.description: { entries: { id, source, amount, timestamp, reason }[], nextCursor? }

pin.description: Required for custodial create and import/link. Exactly 6 digits.

post.description: PIN is required for every create path. Custodial create: `{ pin, legalTermsVersion }` only — server generates secrets. Import/link: `pin` plus `address` plus `encryptedPrivateKey` or `privateKey` (optional `mnemonic`).
Deprecated. Use POST /api/wallets/{address}/sign-transaction for sends and POST /api/wallets/{address}/export for seed reveal.
Replacement for deprecated POST /api/wallets/private-key. Reveals signing material after PIN check.
Signs and broadcasts server-side. Private key never leaves the server. Returns { txHash, chainId }.
Handles RevenueCat purchase events. Use Authorization: Bearer with REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

post.summary: Arena check-in once per team per UTC day

get.summary: Daily quest checklist per followed team

200.description: { rows, streak, globalRank, total, doneCount, arenaClaimedTeamIds }

post.summary: Forfeit a quest session (burns the UTC day attempt)
Submit an answer for a quest session
Start a timed daily-quest quiz session

get.summary: Fan Rep totals split by source plus per-team Club Rep subtotals
get.description: Sums RepLedgerEntry by repType. fanAmp=Fan, club=Club, playerAmp=Player, dsportsDirect=Direct. totalFanRep is the sum of all four.

200.description: { totalFanRep, fanAmpRep, dsportsDirectRep, clubRep, playerAmpRep, clubRepByTeam[] }

post.summary: Record a client-safe Rep earn (reaction/message/pollVote/share only)
post.description: Amount and repType are server-authoritative. Arena check-in and daily-quest Rep use their dedicated routes. Direct kinds (adminGrant, referralBonus, eventReward) are rejected with 403.

get.summary: Paginated Rep ledger (Fan, Club, Player, and Direct sources)
get.description: Keyset pagination on (createdAt DESC, id DESC). source is fanAmp | club | playerAmp | dsportsDirect. playerChallenge maps to source=playerAmp; Direct grants map to dsportsDirect.

200.description: { entries: [{ id, source, amount, timestamp, reason }], nextCursor? }

bearerAuth.description: Clerk session token. Use Authorization: Bearer <token>.
